content: Implement a Python function merge_ranges(ranges) that accepts an iterable of pairs of integers representing closed intervals and returns a sorted list of non-overlapping intervals. Merge both overlapping and immediately adjacent intervals. The function must not mutate the input and must reject a pair whose start exceeds its end with ValueError. Empty input should return an empty list. Include type hints and explain the time complexity. Then provide examples covering unsorted input, duplicates, nested intervals, negative coordinates, adjacency, and invalid input. Use only the Python standard library and keep validation readable.
